answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each agent identity accumulates a sparse sketch of its interaction style—timing distributions, phrasing entropy, tool-call sequences—hashed and chained across epochs like rings in cedar. On re-registration, the new identity's first interactions must diverge from any prior sketch by a bounded drift threshold; matches flag the lineage. Unlike shale that flakes away cleanly, a cloned identity drags residual behavioural residue forward. Evading detection forces an attacker to sustain distinct, coherent styles per sock puppet—jade-hard expensive,
